data.name: Refuse unsafe smoke publication destinations before deleting any files
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

smoke --publish resolves the user-supplied destination and recursively removes it without an ownership marker or overlap check. Passing a project directory, checkout, ancestor of OUT, or another populated directory can erase unrelated files after the test run. The deletion happens even when pytest fails. This is a source-traced data-loss path, not a deletion reproduced during the audit.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity BLOCKER.

  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:2081-2116: smoke deletes OUT/smoke, runs pytest, then shutil.rmtree(dest, ignore_errors=True) for the unrestricted --publish destination.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:2651-2653 dispatches the public smoke command to this function.
  • tests/test_publish_update_docs.py:23-85 protects receipt selection, collisions and source symlinks; it does not exercise smoke publication destination safety.

Scope

Validate output relationships before tests or writes. Publish into a fresh directory or replace only a directory demonstrably owned by this command. Preserve unrelated destination contents. Keep the existing deliberate refresh of owned smoke artifacts, with an explicit ownership boundary.

Acceptance and verification

  • Tests using disposable sentinels reject checkout roots, source projects, filesystem/home roots, OUT itself, ancestors/descendants that would delete active evidence, and symlink aliases to those targets.
  • An existing unowned nonempty destination is refused with exit 4 before pytest or any deletion; all sentinels remain byte-identical.
  • A failed test run cannot delete an existing publication.
  • Fresh publication and a clearly defined owned-directory refresh still work; interruption cannot expose a half-replaced successful publication.

Boundaries and related work

Do not run destructive probes against real directories. This is separate from KICADROUTE-27, which added receipt coverage, and KICADROUTE-45, which guarded installer symlinks.

data.name: Make the corpus regression gate fail on lost validation and missing evidence
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

The corpus outcome records validation, routing and exit status, but compare checks only process status, increasing numeric counts and newly failing preservation names. It skips a count when either side is missing. A process-PASS run whose native DRC fails returns validation FAIL, routing NOT_RUN, missing counts and no preservation map; compared with a valid baseline, this produces no regressions and corpus check can report PASS. Pair routing can also regress to INCOMPLETE without a higher unconnected count.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/corpus.py:67-85 collects validation/routing/exit_code; :147-175 omits those fields and continues on missing numbers.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:792-801 returns failed validation and NOT_RUN routing when candidate DRC fails.
  • src/kicad_route/corpus.py:200-250 turns an empty regression list into PASS and feeds that status into update.
  • tests/test_hygiene.py:257-298 tests a higher unconnected count, not failed or absent validation evidence.

Scope

Define a comparison contract for process, routing, validation and required evidence. A previously known valid result must never become an accepted unknown. Retain useful comparisons for deliberately incomplete or invalid baselines, with explicit status transitions.

Acceptance and verification

  • A valid baseline followed by process PASS / validation FAIL / routing NOT_RUN / missing DRC and preservation evidence fails corpus check and after_update.
  • Validation PASS to FAIL fails even when all numeric counts are unchanged.
  • COMPLETE to INCOMPLETE fails even if pair evidence changes without increasing unconnected_in_scope.
  • Removal of a required preservation check or counter is reported as missing evidence, not an improvement.
  • Unchanged valid runs pass; legitimate improvements remain reported; existing refusal and incomplete-baseline behavior is tested explicitly.

Boundaries and related work

Do not weaken native checks or force all intentionally incomplete corpus entries to become complete. No runtime reproduction was performed in this audit.

data.name: Bind the result evidence hash to the final graded candidate board
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

evidence.candidate_board_sha256 is taken from validation.delivered_board_sha256, which now correctly means the board before KiCad refill. The public candidate path points to the board after refill/save. When refill changes bytes, the evidence hash does not identify the artifact being handed to the caller, and determinism labels this pre-refill hash candidate_bytes.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:790-803 distinguishes delivered, validated and final candidate hashes.
  • src/kicad_route/evidence.py:74-98 selects delivered_board_sha256 for candidate_board_sha256.
  • src/kicad_route/determinism.py:33-48 consumes that field as candidate_bytes.
  • tests/test_evidence_manifest.py:253-258 equates final and pre-refill hashes on a fixture that does not expose the distinction.
  • Inherited artifact build/owned-engine-migration/comparisons/four-layer-plane/candidate-2/run/result.json: evidence hash a10f30735f774b422ecc74208fe38ade8572ac8ad46719354c4142eb38f9c1c6; validated/final hash 9522498140172ddb6df7f52fc9607e4e15d87cbe26a6c3ed042f681258cb82f9; refill_modified_board=true.

Scope

Make the evidence field identify the actual final candidate. Preserve the distinct pre-refill/backend-output hashes and document their meanings. Apply the same contract to initial routing and revalidation records.

Acceptance and verification

  • A fixture whose refill changes board bytes proves evidence.candidate_board_sha256 equals the bytes at candidate.board and validation.candidate_board_sha256.
  • The pre-refill digest remains separately available and differs in that fixture.
  • Determinism's candidate_bytes layer compares post-refill delivered artifacts; backend-output comparison remains independent.
  • Both route schemas and revalidation receipts retain explicit compatibility behavior, with tests for unchanged and changed refills.

Boundaries and related work

data.name: Key baseline DRC caches by grading identity and publish complete cache entries
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

Baseline DRC reuse depends only on input file hashes. After KiCad or grading behavior changes, the same OUT can compare a freshly graded candidate with an old baseline. The selected board is also absent from the key, so two boards in the same snapshotted directory can share one entry. Cache construction writes the DRC report, metadata and pour facts separately; readers accept the first two without validating a complete generation.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:191-198 hashes manifest files only.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:346-373 uses .cache/baseline/<fingerprint>, accepts truthy report/info and writes report, info, then pour facts.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:774 and :826-853 consume the cached report for native violation deltas.
  • src/kicad_route/pour.py:48-73 separately reads or regenerates baseline-pour.json.
  • src/kicad_route/campaign.py:465-479 warms the cache before a campaign, but independent CLI invocations can still share OUT.

Scope

Include selected board, native grader identity and relevant grading/configuration/schema identity in cache identity. Publish DRC, metadata and pour facts as one verified generation. Treat old/incomplete/malformed entries as misses. Record the baseline identity in run evidence.

Acceptance and verification

  • Unchanged input and grader hit the cache; changing the selected board, kicad-cli identity or grading schema causes a miss.
  • No old-tool baseline is silently reused after a tool change; the result identifies the actual baseline generation.
  • Concurrent writers/readers and interruption between each cache write cannot yield a mixed-generation hit.
  • Missing or malformed report/info/pour evidence triggers safe recomputation without modifying the source project.
  • Sandbox and campaign cache reuse remain supported with writable OUT and read-only tools.

Boundaries and related work

No need to reroute to test cache-key and publication logic. Use isolated fake grader outputs for concurrency/failure tests, followed by a bounded native integration case.

data.name: Make owned board-writer scans quote-aware and guarantee forward progress
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

move_copper_text_to_silkscreen counts every parenthesis, including characters inside quoted gr_text strings. If a valid text string contains enough unmatched literal opening parentheses, the scan never finds depth zero, end stays equal to start, and the outer loop sets i=end and repeats forever. The helper runs for every gr_text before checking its layer, so ordinary silkscreen text can trigger it. A final quote-aware balance check cannot rescue a loop that never reaches it.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/router/py_router/kicad_writer.py:48-89 initializes end=start, counts raw parentheses, and sets i=end.
  • kicad_writer.py:1000-1032 and :1073-1129 call this transformation from both public board writers.
  • kicad_writer.py:246-310 repeats raw parenthesis scanning for graphics.
  • kicad_writer.py:1516-1547 already distinguishes quoted strings and escapes in its final balance check.

Scope

Use a quote/escape-aware S-expression boundary reader for the affected writer transformations. Require every scan to advance or raise a diagnostic error. Preserve valid quoted contents exactly.

Acceptance and verification

  • Valid gr_text containing '((', ')', escaped quotes, escaped backslashes and embedded '(gr_text' terminates and round-trips correctly on copper and non-copper layers.
  • Tests exercise both add_tracks_to_pcb and add_tracks_and_vias_to_pcb with those inputs.
  • Truncated or malformed blocks raise a useful error instead of hanging or rewriting the rest of the board.
  • A small native KiCad fixture with literal-parenthesis text routes or returns a normal graded failure within budget, without text loss.

Boundaries and related work

Static causal trace, not an executed hang. Keep reproduction subprocesses isolated with short timeouts; do not use the shared routing state. Do not replace the whole parser without evidence that it is necessary.

data.name: Preserve input copper text and artwork in the owned routing writer
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

The owned writer still unconditionally moves board copper text and qualifying net-less copper graphics to silkscreen. kicad-route explicitly reports this limitation and then fails its copper_graphics preservation check. With the router now owned locally, this inherited behavior prevents valid routing candidates for boards whose input copper artwork must remain intact.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Compatibility enhancement; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/router/py_router/kicad_writer.py:33-95 and :214-315 implement layer relocation.
  • kicad_writer.py:1027-1032 and :1124-1129 invoke relocation unconditionally.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1349-1364 discloses this behavior as unsupported and relies on preservation to catch it.
  • tests/test_preservation_facts.py covers detection of copper graphics changes; KICADROUTE-41 fixed detection, not the writer behavior.

Scope

Make the owned routing path preserve all input copper artwork and text. Model retained copper as obstacles where supported; refuse unsupported geometry before routing rather than silently relocating it. Keep exact input geometry, layers and text under the existing preservation contract.

Acceptance and verification

  • Boards with F.Cu/B.Cu text and net-less board graphics retain those objects and pass copper_graphics preservation after routing.

data.name: Use owned source and installed build hashes in run-ledger fingerprints
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

The ledger still reduces backend identity to version, repository commit, Rust version and jar sha256. It ignores the owned source digest, compiled extension hash and numerical environment. Engine edits without a version/commit change, or rebuilt same-version binaries, can be refused as identical failed attempts. Conversely an unrelated repository commit changes the fingerprint even when the engine is unchanged.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity MINOR.

  • src/kicad_route/ledger.py:28,51-61 defines VERSION_KEYS and the failure fingerprint.
  • src/kicad_route/engine.py:12-30 provides source_sha256 and calls the repository commit informational.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1051-1055 passes krt_version into ledger.check; :1338-1346 reports a Rust version but no extension digest.
  • src/kicad_route/statemanifest.py:354-385 and evidence.py:101-117 already distinguish source, compiled module and package identities.
  • tests/test_hygiene.py:138-160 varies version/commit, not the owned source or installed binary.

Scope

Define one content-based execution identity for the ledger and replay evidence. Preserve readable upstream provenance separately. Document compatibility for old ledger rows and keep --force behavior.

Acceptance and verification

  • Changing source bytes, compiled extension bytes or the relevant dependency environment permits a new attempt despite unchanged semantic versions.
  • An unrelated documentation commit does not change the engine identity.
  • Installed packages without Git metadata still get distinct content-based identities.
  • An actually identical failed attempt is refused; --force and old-row handling remain deterministic.
  • Fingerprint reconstruction from result.json agrees with the stored ledger fingerprint, including protect-human settings.

Boundaries and related work

This is not permission to change the repeat-refusal policy or add a new database. Prefer the existing identity machinery.

data.name: Stage router environment updates so installation failures preserve the working build
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

update_krt upgrades packages in the live routing venv before compiling the extension, then replaces the extension before running startup checks. A dependency, build or startup failure can leave a mixed environment. update catches the error and still refreshes the state manifest from that partial state. The atomic .so replacement protects only the previous binary against build/import failure, not the environment as a whole.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Reliability enhancement; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1725-1741 orders live dependency upgrade, build, then startup checks.
  • src/kicad_route/router/build_router.py:24-59 validates a new extension then atomically replaces the installed module.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1822-1854 catches backend errors and refreshes manifest before returning failure.
  • tests/test_owned_build.py covers invalid native library replacement, not dependency/startup failure or concurrent routing.
  • docs/routing-engine-migration.md:31-43 defines the owned build and state identity.

Scope

Prepare a complete candidate routing environment off the active path, validate it, then activate an immutable generation with its manifest. Serialize overlapping updates and keep the previous generation available for recovery. Make failed installation state explicit.

Acceptance and verification

  • Injected dependency-install, Cargo-build, extension-import and startup-check failures leave the prior active environment and manifest unchanged and usable.
  • A successful activation identifies one coherent source/module/package generation.
  • A routing process started before activation retains a usable environment; new runs see the selected new generation.
  • Concurrent updates cannot share temporary artifacts or publish competing partial manifests.
  • Cold install and recovery after interrupted preparation have documented, tested outcomes.

Boundaries and related work

Preserve the existing policy that corpus regressions are reported rather than silently rolled back unless the owner separately changes it. This item covers installation preparation/activation failures, not an implicit new post-qualification rollback policy.

data.name: Propagate failed determinism qualification through update's exit code and receipt
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

update runs the determinism check and prints NOT reproducible when it fails, but returns only the earlier smoke/corpus rc. If smoke and corpus pass, a failed repeat check can still yield update exit 0. The update receipt is written before determinism and does not contain its outcome, leaving automation to parse logs or inspect a separate manifest.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1839-1862 writes update.json, runs corpus.after_update, calls determinism.check, then returns rc unchanged.
  • src/kicad_route/determinism.py:109-124 can return record_error when recording fails.
  • src/kicad_route/determinism.py:127-153 gives the standalone command a nonzero result for failed qualification or recording.
  • KICADROUTE-7 added the post-update repeat check; this is an uncovered propagation edge.

Scope

Include determinism outcome, reasons and record locator in update.json and make a failed required repeat check or recording failure produce a nonzero update result. Preserve the outcomes of earlier stages.

Acceptance and verification

  • Smoke/corpus PASS plus reproducible=false makes update fail and records why.
  • record_error makes update fail and is visible in the machine-readable receipt.
  • All gates passing returns zero; earlier failures cannot be overwritten by a later pass.
  • Tests isolate update orchestration with controlled check results; no network, package upgrade or full routing suite is needed for these cases.

Boundaries and related work

Do not silently restore older state or redefine deterministic geometry. This can be fixed independently of staged installation.

data.name: Do not label wall-clock-stopped routing attempts as reproducible measurements
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

run_attempt copies measurement and reproducible from the installed build's determinism record without considering the current run's budget/stall/kill flags. A graceful budget stop can still return process PASS and a candidate, so it can be labeled a reproducible measurement even though its stopping point depends on wall-clock scheduling. The repeat checker already rejects exactly these flags as proof of determinism.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Defect; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1219-1278 records budget_reached/stalled/killed and stop_requested.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1447-1467 permits a gracefully stopped candidate to proceed to grading.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:1129-1137 assigns build-level reproducibility directly to the result.
  • src/kicad_route/determinism.py:40-45,57-63 classifies wall-clock stops as unqualified.
  • src/kicad_route/statemanifest.py:387-407 has no current-run input.

Scope

Separate build-level repeat evidence from current-attempt measurement qualification. Any wall-clock stop must leave measurement false and provide a reason, while retaining the candidate and its independent native grade.

Acceptance and verification

  • With a reproducible installed build, budget_reached, stalled or killed in any relevant command makes the current result measurement=false.
  • A graceful stop may still produce a valid/incomplete candidate; its process/routing/validation meanings are unchanged.
  • Normal unstopped deterministic runs retain the existing positive qualification; Freerouting remains an attempt.
  • Single-ended and multi-pass differential routing, revalidation and schemas document/test the distinction.

Boundaries and related work

This does not require a universal claim about every board or backend setting. Do not discard useful partial candidates.

data.name: Publish self-verifiable receipt bundles without stale files or destination-symlink writes
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

publish flattens validate receipts but copies result.json unchanged, so evidence.records paths such as validate/candidate-drc.json no longer locate the published file. Reusing a destination can retain obsolete receipts or change collision placement. Source symlinks are skipped, but existing destination file symlinks are followed by write_bytes, allowing publication to overwrite a file outside the requested bundle.

data.name: Make installed wheels support runtime resources and campaign subprocesses
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

pyproject declares an installable console script and includes owned router assets, but runtime helpers still assume a source checkout. TOOL_ROOT is derived as parents[2] of common.py; in a wheel this is not the repository. Campaign invokes TOOL_ROOT/bin/kicad-route, fixture/canary/determinism expect TOOL_ROOT/fixtures, and smoke expects TOOL_ROOT/tests. A wheel can import the owned engine while these public workflows remain unusable.

Evidence

  • pyproject.toml:1-30 declares setuptools packaging and the kicad-route entry point; package data is scoped to router assets.
  • src/kicad_route/common.py:25-26 derives TOOL_ROOT and default STATE from source layout.
  • src/kicad_route/campaign.py:53 constructs the subprocess path from TOOL_ROOT/bin/kicad-route.
  • src/kicad_route/cli.py:121,2088-2091 resolves fixtures/tests under TOOL_ROOT; contract.py:25 resolves schemas there.
  • tests/test_owned_router.py:31-37 removes Git metadata logically but still reads engine assets from the source tree; it is not a wheel-only acceptance test.

Scope

Separate installed runtime resources, writable state and development-checkout resources. Use a package/entrypoint invocation for child CLIs. Ship resources needed by supported installed commands and explicitly refuse checkout-only developer commands when unavailable.

data.name: Add a fast owned-router regression gate for obstacle state and search invariants
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

The owned source contains eight Rust modules and a large Python routing implementation, but only the two motivating fork regression files were retained under router/tests. The normal smoke command runs wrapper tests and invokes those two files; no Rust test declarations were found in the eight owned Rust sources. Native board checks catch bad candidates but do not efficiently localize obstacle-cache desynchronization or search changes before expensive full-board runs.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Test-protection enhancement; failure severity SERIOUS.

  • src/kicad_route/router/tests contains test_krt64_tap_grid.py and test_pour_launch_forbidden_layer_welds.py.
  • tests/test_engine_regressions.py:11-35 invokes exactly those two scripts.
  • src/kicad_route/router/rust_router/src/obstacle_map.rs:8-19 requires the bitmap to agree with refcounts across add/remove/merge; :117-164 grows/remaps the bitmap.
  • src/kicad_route/router/rust_router/src/pair_search.rs and lane_search.rs specify deterministic ordering and Python-equivalent costs.
  • Makefile:15-18 and cli.py:2081-2091 expose the full Python smoke suite, not a dedicated kernel gate.

Scope

Recover the relevant pinned upstream/fork tests for maintained routing code, classify their dependencies, and add focused tests for bitmap/refcount synchronization and deterministic lane/pair search. Provide a fast local gate separate from native integration, with explicit coverage boundaries.

Acceptance and verification

  • Add/remove/merge/overlap sequences assert bitmap and authoritative blocked-cell membership agree, including growth and overflow windows.
  • Search cases assert obstacle avoidance, permitted layers, deterministic tie ordering, empty/no-path cases and pair heading/via constraints against a small independent oracle or retained reference.
  • Tests run against the owned extension/source without vendor/krt or network acquisition.
  • A documented fast command fails on deliberate invariant-breaking mutants; native KiCad integration remains a separate required gate.
  • Inventory retained, replaced and excluded upstream tests with reasons; do not count unrelated tool-registry failures as routing coverage.

Boundaries and related work

No coverage-percentage target and no algorithm rewrite in this work item. KICADROUTE-67 was cancelled with the external fork workflow; this ticket establishes protection for the owned engine instead of reopening that fork task.

data.name: Strengthen the router benchmark's quality gate and resource measurements
data.description_html:
Problem and impact

The comparison script excludes warmups from both timing and correctness checks, does not retain routing.status or pair completion in quality(), and reports rather than gates copper equivalence. Maximum RSS is the largest individual process, not peak concurrent process-tree memory. The four retained migration boards are useful but do not establish behavior for dense designs or long rescue phases. These are bounded harness gaps; they do not invalidate the historical manual audit of all 32 migration attempts.

Evidence

Source: kicad-route f0c09ac3b8d39a6674a734d3caaa9d7e3ae9633d, reviewed 2026-10-20. Benchmark enhancement; failure severity MINOR.

  • scripts/compare_router.py:17-52 evaluates measured samples only and returns copper_geometry_equal separately from passed.
  • scripts/compare_router.py:55-66 omits routing.status, pair status and wall-clock-stop flags from quality.
  • scripts/compare_router.py:72-91 uses GNU time %M; :117-129 stores warmups outside the compare inputs.
  • tests/test_engine_acceptance.py has one negative case: a faster candidate with one lost connection.
  • docs/routing-engine-migration.md:47-83 records the owner's 10 percent gates and explicitly bounds the four-board evidence and RSS interpretation.

Scope

Separate all-attempt correctness from measured-sample performance. Make the equivalence policy explicit for migration versus future algorithm changes. Add bounded, source-pinned workload coverage and record aggregate peak memory separately from legacy per-process RSS, without claiming unmeasured speedups.

Acceptance and verification

  • A failed warmup, missing quality evidence, routing COMPLETE-to-INCOMPLETE transition, failed pair, or wall-clock-censored sample cannot produce a clean qualification.
  • Migration-equivalence mode fails changed copper geometry; an intentional algorithm-change mode documents its independent acceptance criteria.
  • At least three measured repetitions, separate warmup, raw samples and tool/input identities remain recorded per board; time and memory limits stay at 1.10 unless the owner changes them.
  • The report distinguishes legacy GNU-time RSS from concurrent process-tree peak memory and states which metric each gate enforces.
  • Include an authorized dense/multipoint/rescue workload or a sanitized representative fixture, preserving native correctness and no-rule-relaxation checks.
  • Unit cases exercise exactly 1.10, above-limit ratios, absent/invalid metrics and every quality rejection without running real benchmarks.

Boundaries and related work

Do not silently reinterpret or revoke the completed migration receipt. Do not upload private boards, add paid infrastructure or optimize routing algorithms in this harness change.
